defs.def: to happen; to start to exist 尤指问题或困境

ex.s: Of course, the greatest dilemmas arise from moral problems, when we are uncertain which choice results in doing the right thing.
ex.t: 当然，最大的困境源于道德问题，当我们不确定哪种选择才能做对时。

ex.s: T F 3 The people who live on Changyu Island must be prepared to put up with difficulties when storms arise.
ex.t: 判断对错　3 住在长屿岛上的人们必须做好准备，在暴风雨来临时忍受困难。

defs.def: to happen as a result of a particular situation （由 … ）引起；（因 … ）产生

ex.s: Now a team of researchers led by Damián Blasi at the University of Zurich, Switzerland, has found how and why this trend arose.
ex.t: 如今，由瑞士苏黎世大学的达米安·布拉西领导的研究团队，发现了这一趋势产生的方式和原因。

defs.def: to begin to exist or develop 出现；产生；发展

ex.s: Dangers will arise in any place, at any time, but presence of mind will often conquer the worst of them.
ex.t: 危险随时随地都会出现，但镇定自若往往能战胜其中最坏的处境。

ex.s: As the technology continues to develop at a fast pace, however, questions arise about how to use it appropriately.
ex.t: 然而，随着技术持续快速发展，关于如何恰当使用它的问题也随之产生。

defs.def: to get out of bed; to stand up 起床；起立；起身

ex.s: I will arise and go now, for always night and day I hear lake water lapping with low sounds by the shore; While I stand on the roadway, or on the pavements grey, I hear it in the deep heart’s core.
ex.t: 我就要起身走了，因为日日夜夜我总听到湖水在岸边轻轻拍岸；当我站在路上，或灰色的人行道上，我在内心深处听到了那水声。

defs.def: to come together to protest about sth or to fight for sth 群起反对；奋起斗争
to become visible gradually as you move towards it 山、高大建筑物等
